One. Where will the friends meet?
Boy: Shall we meet at the station?
Girl: The station is busy. Let’s meet outside the library, not at the cafe.

Two. How will the boy go to town?
Girl: Are you cycling today?
Boy: My bicycle needs repairs. I will go by bus. Walking would take too long.

Three. Which way should the girl turn?
Girl: Do I turn left at the corner?
Man: No. Turn right. Do not go straight past the shop.

Four. What will the girl visit?
Boy: Do you want to go to the zoo?
Girl: I saw it last week. Today I want to see the paintings in the gallery.

Five. What does the boy need to write with?
Woman: Use a pen for this form, please.
Boy: I have a pencil.
Woman: Please borrow a pen from the desk. Do not use your phone.
